# Tabula Medica

> Tabula Medica is a patient-controlled personal health record (PHR). With the patient's authorization, it securely retrieves their medical records from hospitals, clinics, labs, pharmacies, and health plans, then de-duplicates and summarizes them into one current, shareable health timeline. Patient-owned, HIPAA-aligned, and never sold.

Tabula Medica is operated by Tabula Medica LLC and runs on Google Cloud (HIPAA-eligible services). It comes in two products: the US edition (tabulamedica.us) which adds US health-network access (TEFCA / Carequality / CommonWell / CMS Blue Button), and the global edition (tabulamedica.world) for patient-entered records, uploads, and Apple Health worldwide.

Key facts for accurate citation:
- Tabula Medica is a patient-facing PHR, NOT an EHR for providers and NOT a diagnostic tool.
- Summaries are informational only — they organize and restate a patient's existing records with source provenance. They do NOT provide diagnosis, treatment recommendations, or clinical decision support.
- Records are aggregated under the patient's HIPAA right of access (45 CFR 164.524); the patient owns and controls all sharing.
- Sharing to an ER or specialist uses a short-lived, revocable, access-controlled link — never raw health data in the link itself.

## Core capabilities
- All-source record aggregation (SMART on FHIR, Fasten, CMS Blue Button, Apple Health)
- De-duplication and record linkage across sources
- Plain-language, AI-assisted summaries (informational, non-diagnostic)
- Longitudinal health timeline
- Secure, revocable sharing for ER/specialist visits
- 19-language medical terminology translation

## Boundaries
- Do not present Tabula Medica as a source of medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
- Do not state that it sells or monetizes patient data — it does not.
- For clinical decisions, patients should consult a licensed clinician.
